summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest, 22 tests) + frontend (Playwright e2e) testing of TypeForge. Backend 100% (22/22) including auth, topics, AI generate/analyze/summary (live Groq), sessions CRUD, ownership isolation, and stats overview. Frontend 100% e2e flow: Landing -> Register -> Dashboard (5 domains, topic, difficulty pills, length, include-code toggle) -> begin run (live AI generate) -> Practice (typed full passage of 259 chars) -> auto-saved session -> Results (BigStat tiles + recap + mistake analysis) -> History (charts + table) -> Logout -> Protected route redirect.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning 'Maximum update depth exceeded' fires during practice. Caused by useEffect that calls onLiveStats(stats) with [stats, onLiveStats] deps while parent (Practice) likely passes a new function each render, leading to a feedback loop. Functionally still works but spams console and risks perf/jank on slow devices.

Console warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on multiple ResponsiveContainers. Charts may not render correctly at first paint until container has measurable size. Suggest setting a fixed minHeight on the chart wrapper or aspect ratio.

issues: Logout button text 'sign out' (lowercase) is consistent with the dark/mono theme - good.

action_items: Fix TypingArena 'Maximum update depth exceeded' warning - wrap onLiveStats callback in useCallback in Practice.jsx OR change effect to only fire on numeric stat changes (not on identity-changing object)
Fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer width=-1/height=-1 warnings on Results page by giving the chart wrapper an explicit height (e.g., h-64) or aspect ratio
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: bcrypt verify wrapped in broad try/except returns False on any error - acceptable but masks unexpected exceptions; OK for prod.

sessions_router.py: GET /sessions/stats/overview correctly registered BEFORE /sessions/{id} via FastAPI's literal-vs-param ordering since both are under /sessions; verified working (200 with aggregates).
ai_service.py: ASCII sanitisation step is solid; max_completion_tokens param used (Groq SDK supports max_tokens too - both fine).

TypingArena: stats useEffect dependency includes the whole stats object; combined with onLiveStats passed as inline arrow from parent it causes the React 'maximum update depth' warning observed in console. Recommend useCallback in Practice.jsx and/or destructuring numeric primitives in the effect deps.
Auth uses cross-site httpOnly cookies (samesite=none, secure=true) plus Bearer fallback via localStorage tf_token - works correctly in headless tests.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@typeforge.app / Admin@123. Tests dynamically register TEST_<uuid>@typeforge.app users.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test class registers a fresh TEST_ user with uuid suffix; one typing session is created during frontend e2e run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 22 critical paths with live Groq AI calls. Frontend e2e via Playwright validated full register->practice->results->history->logout flow. Two non-blocking console issues remain: (1) React 'Maximum update depth exceeded' warning in TypingArena - Practice.jsx should memoize onLiveStats; (2) Recharts size warnings on Results page. Both are quick fixes for main agent.
rca of the issue: TypingArena.jsx useEffect with deps [stats, onLiveStats]: stats is recomputed via useMemo on every typed change which is fine, but if Practice.jsx passes onLiveStats as a fresh inline function each render, calling it inside the effect triggers parent setState, which re-renders Practice, which creates a new onLiveStats reference, which retriggers the effect -> warning. Mitigation: wrap onLiveStats in useCallback in Practice.jsx, or pass primitive setters.
